title: Concrete cartesian open restriction of pullback Hom
statement: For schemes s:Y → S, r:T → S and B open in Y, construct b:B ×_S T → Y ×_S T by pullback.map with B.ι, identity T and identity S. Given a:derivedPullback(B.ι) ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage(B.ι), form the comparison κ from the fixed composition comparisons, the equation b followed by the original projection equals the restricted projection followed by B.ι, and the mate comparing a with schemeMVAdjunction. Define restriction of a Hom f by κ(M).inv followed by derivedPullback(b).map(f) followed by κ(Q).hom. These are the same three concrete definitions formerly stated in the parent module, with unchanged signatures and bodies. [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport, def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data].
